mapper.select: SELECT ENPSWD FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_USER SET ENPSWD = #{enpswd}, ACNT_STTS_CD = #{acntSttsCd}, LGN_FAIL_NMTM = 0, MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.sql: U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NM AS userNm, U.TEAM_SN AS teamSn, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, U.JBGD_CD AS jbgdCd, J.CD_NM AS jbgdNm, U.AUTHRT_CD AS authrtCd, A.CD_NM AS authrtNm, U.ACNT_STTS_CD AS acntSttsCd, S.CD_NM AS acntSttsNm, U.TELNO AS telno, U.EML_ADDR AS emlAddr, U.REG_DT AS regDt

FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = U.TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD J ON J.GROUP_CD = 'JBGDS' AND J.CD = U.JBGD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD A ON A.GROUP_CD = 'AUTHS' AND A.CD = U.AUTHRT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD S ON S.GROUP_CD = 'ACSTS' AND S.CD = U.ACNT_STTS_CD
mapper.select:
SELECT
AND (U.USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR UPPER(U.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ESCAPE '\')
AND U.ACNT_STTS_CD = #{status}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN U.ACNT_STTS_CD = 'AS050' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, T.TEAM_NM, U.USER_NM
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER (USER_ID, USER_NM, TEAM_SN, JBGD_CD, AUTHRT_CD, ENPSWD, ACNT_STTS_CD, TELNO, EML_ADDR, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userNm}, #{teamSn,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{jbgdCd}, #{authrtCd}, #{enpswd}, #{acntSttsCd}, #{telno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{emlAddr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rgtrId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_USER SET USER_NM = #{userNm}, TEAM_SN = #{teamSn,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, JBGD_CD = #{jbgdCd}, AUTHRT_CD = #{authrtCd}, TELNO = #{telno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EML_ADDR = #{emlAddr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE TB_USER SET ACNT_STTS_CD = #{acntSttsCd}, MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT DEPT_CD FROM TB_TEAM WHERE TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT TO_CHAR(TEAM_SN) AS code, TEAM_NM AS name, DEPT_CD AS extra FROM TB_TEAM WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DEPT_CD, TEAM_NM
SELECT CD AS code, CD_NM AS name FROM TB_COM_CD WHERE GROUP_CD = 'JBGDS' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ
